question_en: Which of the following statements about primary and secondary markets is least accurate?
option_a: A primary market is a market in which new securities are sold.
option_b: The proceeds from a sale in the secondary market go to the issuer.
option_c: The primary market benefits from the liquidity provided by the secondary market.
explanation_en: Proceeds in a primary market go to the issuing firm. Proceeds from a sale in the secondary market go to the current owner who is selling the securities.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Equity Investments\Reading 41 Market Organization and Structure - Answers.pdf
question_en: The main functions of the financial system least likely include:
option_a: allocating financial resources to their most productive uses.
option_c: preventing investors from generating abnormal profits by trading on information.
explanation_en: One of the purposes of the financial system is to allow investors to trade on (public) information. Other purposes of the financial system include allocating financial capital to its most productive uses, and bringing together those who wish to save with those who wish to borrow.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Equity Investments\Reading 41 Market Organization and Structure - Answers.pdf
question_en: When using margin to invest in equities, which of the following defines initial margin and what level will the margin be brought back to in the event of a margin call? Initial Margin Margin Call Action
option_a: minimum amount of equity required of the investor a deposit must be made to bring the margin back to the initial margin
option_b: minimum amount of equity required of the investor a deposit must be made to bring the margin back to the maintenance margin
option_c: amount of borrowed funds in the transactions a deposit must be made to bring the margin back to the maintenance margin
explanation_en: The initial margin requirement refers to the minimum amount of equity required of the investor. With equities, if the margin falls below the maintenance margin, funds must be deposited to bring it back up to the maintenance margin level.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Equity Investments\Reading 41 Market Organization and Structure - Answers.pdf
question_en: Which of the following assets are best characterized as contracts?
explanation_en: Contracts include forwards, futures, options, swaps, and insurance contracts. Commercial paper is a debt security. Depository receipts are shares in a pooled investment vehicle, such as a mutual fund or an exchange-traded fund.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Equity Investments\Reading 41 Market Organization and Structure - Answers.pdf
question_en: With respect to a well-functioning securities market, a market that exhibits operational efficiency will have:
option_c: rapid price reactions to new information.
explanation_en: An operationally efficient market is a market in which the cost of each transaction is minimal. Informational efficiency means prices in the market reflect all information currently available to participants. Price continuity means that prices do not adjust much from one transaction to the next unless new information about firm value becomes available.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Equity Investments\Reading 41 Market Organization and Structure - Answers.pdf
question_en: Evelyn Stram, CFA, places a good-till-cancelled limit buy order at 86 for a stock. Stram's order specifies:
explanation_en: Good-till-cancelled is a validity instruction, which indicates when an order may be filled. Execution instructions include limit orders and market orders, as well as instructions regarding trade size and visibility. A clearing instruction indicates how to arrange final settlement of the trade.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Equity Investments\Reading 41 Market Organization and Structure - Answers.pdf
question_en: Regarding the technical points affecting the short sales of a stock, which of the following statements is most accurate?
option_a: Stocks can only be shorted in a down market.
option_b: The lender must deposit margin to guarantee the eventual return of the stock.
option_c: The short seller must pay all dividends due to the lender of the shorted stock.
explanation_en: The short seller must pay any dividends on the stock to the owner of the borrowed shares. The short seller must also deposit margin money to guarantee the eventual repurchase of the security.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Equity Investments\Reading 41 Market Organization and Structure - Answers.pdf
question_en: An electronic crossing network is best described as:
explanation_en: A crossing network is an example of an order-driven market. Orders are batched together and crossed (matched) at specific times during the trading day at prices based on those of another exchange. Price-driven markets and quote-driven markets are other terms for dealer or over-the-counter markets.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Equity Investments\Reading 41 Market Organization and Structure - Answers.pdf
question_en: Which of the following option positions is said to be a long position?
explanation_en: The buyer of an option (either a call or put) is said to be long the option and the writer of an option is said to be short the option. Note that with put options, the long (put option holder) benefits when the price of the underlying asset decreases, while the short (put option writer) benefits when the price of the underlying asset increases. We say that a put buyer is long the option but has short exposure to the underlying asset price.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Equity Investments\Reading 41 Market Organization and Structure - Answers.pdf
question_en: The main functions of the financial system most likely include:
option_a: allocating capital to its most productive uses and determining the supply of money.
option_b: determining equilibrium interest rates and allocating capital to its most productive uses.
option_c: determining the supply of money and determining equilibrium interest rates.
explanation_en: The main functions of the financial system are to allow individuals and organizations to save, borrow, raise capital, and manage risks; to determine equilibrium rates of return that equate the amounts of lending and borrowing; and to allocate capital to its most productive uses. The money supply is typically controlled by countries' central banks.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Equity Investments\Reading 41 Market Organization and Structure - Answers.pdf
question_en: A unique item such as fine art is most likely to be exchanged in a(n):
explanation_en: Brokered markets are typically the best market structure for unique items. A broker adds value by locating a counterparty to take the opposite side of a trade of such an item.

question_en: An investor buys 1,000 shares of a non-dividend-paying stock for $18. The initial margin requirement is 40% and the maintenance margin is 30%. After one year the investor sells the stock for $24 per share. The investor's rate of return on this investment (ignoring borrowing and transactions costs and taxes), and the price at which the investor would receive a margin call, are closest to: Rate of return Margin call
explanation_en: To obtain the result: Part 1: Calculate Margin Return: Margin Return % = [((Ending Value - Loan Payoff) / Beginning Equity Position) – 1] * 100 = = [(([$24 × 1,000] – [$18 × 1,000 × 0.60]) / ($18 × 0.40 × 1,000)) – 1] × 100 = = 83.33% Alternative (Check): Calculate the all cash return and multiply by the margin leverage factor. = [(24,000 – 18,000)/18,000] × [1 / 0.40] = 33.33% × 2.5 = 83.33% Part 2: Calculate Margin Call Price: Since the investor is long (purchased the stock), the formula for the margin call price is: Margin Call = (original price) × (1 – initial margin) / (1 – maintenance margin) = $18 × (1 – 0.40) / (1 – 0.30) = $15.43

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Equity Investments\Reading 41 Market Organization and Structure - Answers.pdf
question_en: Which of the following statements about securities markets is least accurate?
option_a: Characteristics of a well-functioning securities market include: many buyers and sellers, low bid-ask spreads, timely information on price and volume of past transactions, and accurate information on supply and demand.
option_b: A limit buy order and a stop buy order are both placed below the current market price.
option_c: Secondary markets, such as the over-the-counter (OTC) market, provide liquidity and price continuity.
explanation_en: A limit buy is placed below the current market price, but a stop buy order is placed above the current market price (stop buy orders are often placed to protect a short sale from a rising market). The other choices are true. A well-functioning securities market includes the following characteristics: timely and accurate information on price and volume of past transactions. timely and accurate information on the supply and demand for current transactions. liquidity (as indicated by low bid-ask spreads). marketability. price continuity. depth (many buyers and sellers). operational efficiency (low transaction costs). informational efficiency (rapidly adjusting prices).

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Equity Investments\Reading 41 Market Organization and Structure - Answers.pdf
question_en: A primary market transaction involves:
option_a: the sale of new securities to investors.
option_c: direct trading of securities between institutional investors.
explanation_en: A primary market is a market for new issues of securities.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Equity Investments\Reading 41 Market Organization and Structure - Answers.pdf
question_en: Equity securities most likely include:
option_a: preferred stock and certicates of deposit.
explanation_en: Common stock, preferred stock, and warrants are equity securities. Certificates of deposit are debt securities. Exchange-traded funds are pooled investment vehicles.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Equity Investments\Reading 41 Market Organization and Structure - Answers.pdf
question_en: A short seller:
option_b: loses if the price of the stock sold short decreases.
option_c: often also places a stop loss sell order.
explanation_en: The short seller pays all dividends to the lender, loses if stock prices rise, and is required to post a margin account. A short seller often places a stop buy order to protect the short sale position from a rising market.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Equity Investments\Reading 41 Market Organization and Structure - Answers.pdf
question_en: Which of the following statements about selling a stock short is least likely accurate?
option_a: The seller must inform their broker that the order is a short sale before completing the transaction.
option_b: The short seller may withdraw the proceeds of the short sale.
option_c: The seller must return the securities at the request of the lender.
explanation_en: Proceeds from the short sale must remain in the brokerage account along with the required margin deposit.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Equity Investments\Reading 41 Market Organization and Structure - Answers.pdf
question_en: Jerry Slotz enters an exchange-traded contract that obligates him to purchase a specific amount of an asset on a future date. The contract is most likely:
explanation_en: Futures contracts are standardized contracts traded on an exchange that obligate one party to purchase and one party to sell a specific amount of an asset at a specified price on a specified future date. Forward contracts are similar to futures contracts but are customizable (i.e., not standardized) and traded over-the-counter (i.e., not exchange- traded). Call options can be traded on an exchange; however, they give the holder the right, not the obligation, to purchase the asset at a future date.
